---
name: Feature request
about: Ask for a new collector, flag or output format
labels: enhancement
---

What are you trying to do on your servers? Start with the job, not the feature.

What do you do today instead?

What would you like sudodrift to do? A sample of the output you would want is the best way to explain it.

Anything that must stay true: for example no new dependencies, read only, no network.
